document_plan.rationale_global: Long ToS narratif eBay sans numerotation (numbering=0). La segmentation suit les ruptures thematiques : preambule/incorporation, identite des entites contractantes (META/DEFINITIONS), avertissement arbitrage, role de marketplace, longue liste d'usages interdits (ACCEPTABLE_USE), standards/suspension (TERMINATION), frais et facturation (PAYMENT_BILLING), regles de mise en vente et d'achat (ELIGIBILITY_ACCOUNT), international/traduction (THIRD_PARTY), licence de contenu et PI (LICENSE_IP), catalogue (USER_CONTENT), marques et DMCA (LICENSE_IP), restriction de fonds paypal (THIRD_PARTY), contacts/enregistrement/analyse de messages (PRIVACY_DATA), retours/remboursements (PAYMENT_BILLING), global shipping program (THIRD_PARTY), money back guarantee (PAYMENT_BILLING), disclaimer de garanties (WARRANTY_DISCLAIMER), limitation de responsabilite + release (LIABILITY_LIMITATION), indemnisation (INDEMNIFICATION), longue section legal disputes/arbitrage (DISPUTE_ARBITRATION), forum judiciaire et general/boilerplate (GOVERNING_LAW / MISC_BOILERPLATE), dispositions specifiques aux etats (GOVERNING_LAW). Continuite par defaut au sein de chaque section.
